text:
anya: Heads-up: deploy-bot flagged embeddings.p95 surge after the midnight rollout (release/v2.6.3). Canary hold engaged.
deploy-bot: SAFETY_HOLD: embeddings.p95 > 2x baseline for 3m. Suggested action: investigate, pin, or rollback. Auto-rollback available.
sam: Can we let auto-rollback run? We have a scheduled change window with enterprise customers later today.
julian: Prefer manual to avoid flipping dedicated pools mid-window. If we auto-rollback it could touch reserved capacity.
anya: Agreed — manual operator action. Ops, pin hosted embeddings route to previous-stable tag `v2.6.2` and leave a 1% canary on v2.6.3 for telemetry. Suppress auto-rollback.
ops-runner: Running command: 
```
routerctl pin --route embeddings --to-tag v2.6.2 --canary 1 --reason "p95 spike post-deploy"
```
ops-runner: Pin applied: hosted embeddings 99% -> v2.6.2, 1% canary on v2.6.3. Auto-rollback suppressed by operator.
sre-jen: Looking at metrics: KV eviction rate spiked at merge + small increase in GC on the serving hosts. Possible runtime memory pressure on the new kernels. Opening INF-1902.
kate: Drafting customer-facing note: "Temporarily routing embeddings to previous version due to increased latency; investigating. Next update in 30m." Add legal-bot review?
legal-bot: Reminder: include only factual statements about observable impact; avoid implying SLA violations.
sam: Rollback criteria proposal: if embeddings.p95 > 500ms for 10m OR error_rate > 0.5% for 5m -> trigger targeted rollback for embeddings to v2.6.1 and notify customers. Approve?
julian: Approve with one change: if dedicated-customer error_rate > 0.2% for 3m, escalate to oncall and consider immediate mitigation for those pools.
anya: Approved. Ops, prepare rollback playbook but don't execute unless criteria met. Also prepare quick warmup for v2.6.2 nodes.
ops-runner: Warmup started (prewarm cache + kv priming). Smoke tests queued: auth, search, embeddings-create, batch-embed. ETA 2m.
ops-runner: Smoke: auth OK, search OK, embeddings-create latency returned to baseline on pinned traffic (~240ms), batch embed throughput nominal. Quality sample: 97/100 pass.
sre-jen: Good. Keep suppression for 45m while INF-1902 is investigated. I'll add a regression test for kernel memory pattern.
kate: Customer note scheduled to send if stable for 15m. Draft includes: "temporary routing pin to prior version; no errors observed; monitoring closely."
sam: For release notes, add a blurb under "deployments": v2.6.3 paused for embeddings due to increased p95; fix in progress.
julian: FYI ops: when we unpin, do a staged ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 10m observation windows and auto-rollback ON for hosted-only experiment.
ops-runner: Noted. To re-enable auto-rollback we'll run `deploy-bot revert-suppression` after a coordinated A/B.
anya: Also record the decision: manual pin to avoid touching dedicated pools during our change window. Keep thread updated.
ops-runner: Follow-up after 18m: metrics stable on pinned traffic, p95 230ms, quality checks 99/100.
sre-jen: INF-1902 created and assigned to ml-runtime team. Will post updates in this thread.
kate: Customer advisory sent. (:mailbox_with_mail:)
sam: Marking incident as mitigated but not closed. We'll keep suppression until fix lands and a safe A/B is executed.
anya: Closing loop for now: manual pin applied, auto-rollback suppressed, warmup & smoke verified, ticket created. Reopen if telemetry regresses. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
